scope: Marginal pricing for one artifact held continuously for one month or one year. Included allowances are excluded. Transfers and operations are separate from storage.
unit: 1 billed GB-month. Convex publishes GB but does not define decimal versus binary GB for file-storage billing, so this is the provider's own billed unit rather than a bytes-to-GB conversion.

options.name: Convex File Storage
options.operations: No separate file-operation rate is published; direct upload flow uses Convex function calls, which are billed separately by plan.
options.implementation: Native generated upload URL, direct POST, persist storageId, then getUrl. Lowest integration work.
options.oneGiBNote: Direct upload URLs accept arbitrarily large files, but each POST has a 2-minute timeout. Do not route 1 GB through an HTTP action (20 MB request limit) or hold it in a Convex action Blob.

options.name: @convex-dev/r2 component plus Cloudflare R2 Standard
options.provider: Cloudflare R2 billed separately; component runs in Convex

operations.rounding: Monthly usage rounds up to whole million-request units; rates per individual operation above are amortized unit rates, not a standalone invoice.

options.implementation: Configure a bucket, CORS, and R2 credentials in Convex. Component generates signed direct upload URLs and syncs metadata; it does not move object bytes into Convex storage.
options.oneGiBNote: Cloudflare recommends multipart for large/resumable uploads. A single S3 PUT supports up to 5 GiB, but multipart improves retry behavior; multipart has at least three Class A operations.

options.name: @hasoo/convex-s3 component plus AWS S3
options.provider: AWS S3 Standard, us-east-1, billed separately; community component runs in Convex

transfer.basis: first 10 TB/month tier; excludes AWS's shared 100 GB/month allowance

options.implementation: Community component provides presigned direct upload/download URLs and optional stable public URLs. Requires an S3 bucket, IAM access, CORS, and optionally a CDN domain.
options.oneGiBNote: The figures are the S3 Standard us-east-1 usage rates with no allowance. Use multipart-capable S3 tooling for resilient large uploads.

d2: No Cloudflare D2 storage product or Convex D2 component was found. The likely name is Cloudflare D1, a serverless SQLite database; it is not object storage for 1 GB APK/AAB blobs.
recommendation: For a single retained 1 GB artifact with modest downloads, Convex File Storage is simplest and costs $0.033/month marginal on Starter. Choose R2 when direct-download egress, expiring signed URLs, or resilient multipart uploads matter; its storage is $0.015/month plus operations.

hundredDailyInstalls.basis: No allowances; R2 Class A/B monthly usage rounds up to million-operation units. One upload month, one GET per install.
